lines.en: label futabadorm10:
I knock on Futaba's door and wait for an answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等她回应。

lines.en: Our last extended hang out session went pretty well apart from a poorly (Or expertly, based on who you ask) timed call from a certain niece of mine...so I'm sure this one will be just as good if not better.
lines.zh: 我们上次长时间相处得挺顺利，除了一通时机不巧（或者说时机绝妙，就看你问谁了）的电话——来自我某个侄女……所以我相信这次就算不更好，也差不了。

lines.en: I turn my phone off just to be sure. Sorry, Ami.
lines.zh: 为了保险起见，我把手机关了。抱歉啊，Ami。

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嗯……Sensei？

lines.en: : Hey. Good guess.
lines.zh: : 嘿。猜得挺准。

lines.en: : Well...I already told you you're the only person who ever knocks...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我说过的，你是唯一会敲门的人……

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I forgot about the just come in rule.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我忘了“直接进来”那条规矩。

lines.en: : Uhh...wait a second, please! I...don't look...normal right now.
lines.zh: : 呜……请等一下！我现在……样子不太……正常。

lines.en: : Are you...secretly a werewolf or something?
lines.zh: : 你……该不会其实是狼人之类的吧？

lines.en: : Huh? No! Of course not. I just...ummm...hold on.
lines.zh: : 哈？不！当然不是。我只是……嗯……等等。

lines.en: I hear some scuffling from behind the door as Futaba either attempts to reorganize things or make herself look like less of a werewolf.
lines.zh: 我听见门后传来一阵窸窸窣窣的动静，Futaba 要么在整理东西，要么在让自己看起来不那么像狼人。

lines.en: I'll find out soon.
lines.zh: 我很快就会知道了。

lines.en: : Um...sorry...one more minute, please.
lines.zh: : 嗯……抱歉……再给我一分钟。

lines.en: : Okay. But if I count to sixty and don't hear anything again, I'm opening the door.
lines.zh: : 好。但要是我数到六十还没听见动静，我就开门了。

lines.en: : No...you're not.
lines.zh: : 不……你不会的。

lines.en: Damn it.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: I spend the next minute or two standing beside the door, trying to look as normal as I possibly can while waiting for the person inside.
lines.zh: 接下来的一两分钟，我站在门边，尽力让自己看起来正常一点，等着里面那个人。

lines.en: Needless to say, I do not look very normal.
lines.zh: 不用说，我看起来一点都不正常。

lines.en: Okay. What the hell is taking so long?
lines.zh: 好吧。到底在磨蹭什么？

lines.en: : Futaba, is everything okay in there? I'm starting to think the werewolf thing might actually be true.
lines.zh: : Futaba，你里面还好吗？我开始觉得狼人那事可能是真的了。

lines.en: : Ahh! I’m sorry, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 啊！对不起，Sensei……

lines.en: : You can...come in now...but...again, I'm sorry...
lines.zh: : 你……现在可以进来了……不过……再说一次，我很抱歉……

lines.en: Sorry for what, exactly?
lines.zh: 到底抱歉什么？

lines.en: scene black
I open the door, unsure of what I'm going to see or why Futaba was so dead set on hiding it from me.
lines.zh: 我打开门，不知道自己会看到什么，也不知道 Futaba 为什么这么坚决要瞒着我。

lines.en: scene futabadten1
But all I see are two enormous breasts.
lines.zh: 可我看到的，是两座巨大的乳房。

lines.en: : Heeey...
: Sorry you have to see me like this...
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你看到我这副样子……

lines.en: : I was looking around for another pair of normal clothes, but everything is in the wash right now, so...
lines.zh: : 我本来想再找一套正常的衣服，可所有衣服都在洗，所以……

lines.en: Why is she apologizing after blessing me with such a magnificent sight?
lines.zh: 她赐予我如此壮观的景色，为什么还要道歉？

lines.en: It’s no secret that Futaba’s chest is the largest in the class, but like...come on.
lines.zh: Futaba 的胸是全班最大的，这早就不是什么秘密了，可是……拜托。

lines.en: This is just unfair.
lines.zh: 这太不公平了。

lines.en: How am I supposed to contain myself when she's over here basically spilling out of her pajamas?
lines.zh: 她都快从睡衣里溢出来了，我要怎么按捺得住？

lines.en: : You know there's no need to apologize for just being in your pajamas, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道光是穿着睡衣，根本没必要道歉吧？

lines.en: : If anything, this shows that you’ve gotten comfortable around me.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，这反倒说明你在我身边已经自在了。

lines.en: scene futabadten2
: Of course I’m comfortable with you, Sensei...It’s just...
lines.zh: : 我当然在你身边很自在，Sensei……只是……

lines.en: scene futabadten3
: You know...These pajamas are a little...revealing...
lines.zh: : 你知道的……这套睡衣有点……暴露……

lines.en: : So...I'm...sorry if I seem embarrassed or anything...
lines.zh: : 所以……如果我看起来很不好意思什么的……我很抱歉……

lines.en: : I mean, this is fifty times better than you seeing me in my pajamas. So I wouldn't worry too much about it.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，这比你看到我穿睡衣的样子好上五十倍。所以你不用太担心。

lines.en: scene futabadten4
: I doubt that. I really can't imagine what you wear to sleep being any worse than this.
lines.zh: : 我表示怀疑。我真想象不出你睡觉穿的衣服能比这更糟。

lines.en: : Unless it's...one of those really embarrassing one pieces, but...you don't really seem like the type to wear those.
lines.zh: : 除非是……那种特别让人害羞的连体睡衣，不过……你看起来也不像会穿那种的人。

lines.en: : Oh, no. It's nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。不是那种。

lines.en: scene futabadten5
: I figured. There's no way someone like you would-
lines.zh: : 我想也是。像你这样的人绝对不会——

lines.en: : I sleep naked.
lines.zh: : 我睡觉是不穿衣服的。

lines.en: scene futabadten6
: Ah.
: See what I mean?
lines.zh: : 懂我意思了吧？

lines.en: : Hearing that, don't you feel a little less self-conscious of how revealing your pajamas are? Because, it probably goes without saying, but there's nothing quite as revealing as straight up nudity.
lines.zh: : 听了这个，你是不是就不那么在意自己的睡衣有多暴露了？因为不用说也知道，再没有什么比一丝不挂更暴露的了。

lines.en: scene futabadten7
: No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : No, I guess there's not.
lines.zh: : 嗯，大概确实没有。

lines.en: : Futaba?
lines.zh: : Futaba？

lines.en: Uh-oh. I think I might have broken her.
lines.zh: 糟糕。我想我可能把她弄坏了。

lines.en: I take a step closer to Futaba and begin snapping my fingers in her face.
lines.zh: 我朝 Futaba 走近一步，开始在她面前打响指。

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. Come back to life now. We don't have all night, you know.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。快醒醒。我们可没有一整晚的时间。

lines.en: : Naked...
lines.zh: : 不穿衣服……

lines.en: : Sensei...sleeps naked...
lines.zh: : Sensei……睡觉是不穿衣服的……

lines.en: : That's totally normal. That's a totally normal thing I know now.
lines.zh: : 这完全正常。这是我现在知道的、完全正常的一件事。

lines.en: : This is all completely normal. It's fine that he told me that. It's fine that-
lines.zh: : 这一切都完全正常。他告诉我这件事也没关系。就算——也没关系。

lines.en: Sensing that the snapping isn’t having any effect, I poke one of her cheeks with my index finger and she is immediately shocked back to life.
lines.zh: 发现打响指毫无效果，我用食指戳了戳她的脸颊，她立刻像被电了一下似的活了过来。

lines.en: scene futabadten8r
: Ah! I’m so sorry. I must have zoned out for a second!
lines.zh: : 啊！非常抱歉。我一定是走神了！

lines.en: : I think I may have...misheard you because it sounded to me like you said you sleep n-
lines.zh: : 我想我可能……听错了，因为我好像听到你说你睡觉不——

lines.en: scene futabadten6
: Ah.
: Futaba, come on.
lines.zh: : Futaba，别这样。

lines.en: I poke her cheek a second time.
lines.zh: 我又戳了一次她的脸颊。

lines.en: scene futabadten8r
: I’m so sorry! I have no idea what’s gotten into me!
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉！我不知道自己是怎么了！

lines.en: : I believe the scientific term for it would be arousal.
lines.zh: : 我想，用科学术语来说，这叫性唤起。

lines.en: jump futabapokex
label futabapokex:
scene futabadten8
: A-A-A-A-A-Arousal?! No no no no no! That's not what's happening at all!
lines.zh: : 性……性……性唤起？！不不不不不！根本不是那么回事！

lines.en: : Just because I zoned out...thinking about you with...your...no!
lines.zh: : 我只是走神了……想着你……你的……不对！

lines.en: : That's not even remotely close to what's getting into me!
lines.zh: : 这跟我“怎么了”差了十万八千里！

lines.en: : It's not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : Of course not! Not even close! Not even almost close! You're so far off that...it's not even funny!
lines.zh: : 当然不是！差得远了！连边都沾不上！你离谱到……一点都不好笑！

lines.en: : Oh.
: Then I guess I'm alone in feeling that way.
lines.zh: : 那看来，有这种感觉的只有我一个人了。

lines.en: : You're...what?!
: Did you really expect me to be able to see you in that and not react in this way?
lines.zh: : 你真的以为，看到你那副样子我还能毫无反应吗？

lines.en: : At the very least, I didn't expect you to come out and just admit it! We're-
lines.zh: : 我至少没料到你会就这么直接承认！我们——

lines.en: : Student and teacher, right? Is that what you were going to say?
lines.zh: : 学生和老师，对吧？你是想说这个？

lines.en: : Well, what else am I supposed to say in this position?!
lines.zh: : 那我这种处境还能说什么？！

lines.en: : Here I am being super embarrassed about how I look and...you’re busy thinking weird things and completely ignoring that!
lines.zh: : 我都因为自己的样子难为情死了，而你……却在想些奇怪的东西，完全无视了这一点！

lines.en: : You were thinking weird things too, though. And you said them out loud well before I did. I'm just following your example.
lines.zh: : 可你也在想奇怪的东西啊。而且你比我早得多就说出口了。我只是照着你的样子学。

lines.en: scene futabadten10
: It's...different when I say those things about you!
lines.zh: : 我说那些关于你的话时……是不一样的！

lines.en: : How, though?
lines.zh: : 怎么不一样了？

lines.en: scene futabadten11
: B...Because...everyone thinks you're really handsome and stuff...and you're probably used to people...fantasizing about you...
lines.zh: : 因……因为……大家都觉得你很帅什么的……而且你大概早就习惯了别人……对你想入非非……

lines.en: : That's...not a thing I've ever realized someone would actually do about me before...
lines.zh: : 这……我之前从没意识到真的会有人对我做这种事……

lines.en: : If...you are actually doing that and...aren't just messing around with me right now...
lines.zh: : 如果……你真的在做那种事，而且……现在不是在拿我寻开心……

lines.en: : How many times do I have to tell you how attractive you are before you start believing me?
lines.zh: : 我要说多少次你有魅力，你才会开始相信我？

lines.en: : It's not...really that easy to just believe, Sensei...It's a lot more complicated than that.
lines.zh: : 要相信真的……没那么容易，Sensei……事情比这复杂得多。

lines.en: : I'm sure it is, but I'm going to abuse my position right now and exercise my power as your teacher to command that you listen to me.
lines.zh: : 我相信很复杂，不过我现在要滥用一下我的地位，行使我作为你老师的权力，命令你听我的。

lines.en: scene futabadten8
: Are you...commanding me to be aroused?!
lines.zh: : 你……是在命令我产生性唤起？！

lines.en: : No. I am commanding you to accept my arousal without question.
lines.zh: : 不。我命令你毫无异议地接受我的性唤起。

lines.en: scene futabadten10
: That's just as bad! In fact...no! That's even worse!
lines.zh: : 那一样糟糕！事实上……不！那个更糟！

lines.en: This is fun.
lines.zh: 真有意思。

lines.en: scene futabadten11
: I miss the old, non-perverted Sensei...This one is weird and...keeps saying weird things that...make me feel weird...
lines.zh: : 我怀念以前那个不好色的 Sensei……这个 Sensei 很怪，而且……老是说些奇怪的话……让我觉得怪怪的……

lines.en: For some strange reason, I'm beginning to think Futaba may be weirded out right now.
lines.zh: 不知为何，我开始觉得 Futaba 现在可能有点被吓到了。

lines.en: Maybe it's for the best if I back off a little?
lines.zh: 也许我稍微收敛一点比较好？

lines.en: Being too forward with a girl like her might just wind up scaring her away if I'm not careful.
lines.zh: 对像她这样的女孩太主动，一不小心就可能把她吓跑。

lines.en: And after seeing exactly what she has to offer up close and not concealed by a blazer or a button-down, that is not something I am willing to risk.
lines.zh: 而且在近距离看过她的一切、而且没有被西装外套或衬衫遮住之后，我可不愿意冒这个险。

lines.en: : Okay, I'll stop. I didn't mean to make you-
lines.zh: : 好，我打住。我不是故意让你——

lines.en: scene futabadten8r
: Wait, no! I didn't mean it like that! I’m glad you’re a pervert!
lines.zh: : 等等，不是！我不是那个意思！我很高兴你是个色狼！

lines.en: scene futabadten12
: Wait, what?! That’s not what I meant to say! Why did I say that?!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！我不是想说这个！我为什么会说那种话？！

lines.en: : I'm just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: scene futabadten11
: I'm just...really surprised. That’s all...
lines.zh: : 我只是……真的很惊讶。就这样……

lines.en: : I know that boys are generally interested in...breasts and stuff...so I can understand that...reaction from you...
lines.zh: : 我知道男生一般会对……胸部之类的感兴趣……所以我能理解你……那种反应……

lines.en: : I know mine are...on the bigger side...
lines.zh: : 我知道我的……是偏大的那种……

lines.en: They are not just on the bigger side. They have their own fucking team.
lines.zh: 这可不是“偏大”而已。它们他妈的都能自成一队了。

lines.en: : But that’s just because...I’m a little...overweight...
lines.zh: : 可那只是因为……我有点……偏胖……

lines.en: : So it’s not like they’re...particularly...alluring or anything...
lines.zh: : 所以它们也谈不上……特别……迷人什么的……

lines.en: scene futabadten10
: Ahhh! What am I saying?! And why aren’t you stopping me?!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我在说些什么？！你为什么不拦着我？！

lines.en: : Because you're cute, that’s why.
lines.zh: : 因为你很可爱，这就是原因。

lines.en: : And I like you the way you are.
lines.zh: : 而且我就喜欢你现在的样子。

lines.en: scene futabadten13
: Well...you have weird tastes then...because I don't see myself that way at all...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那你的品味还挺怪的……因为我完全不觉得自己是那样……

lines.en: The two of us stand there in silence for a few seconds as Futaba begins to awkwardly look around the room.
lines.zh: 我们两个沉默地站了几秒，Futaba 开始尴尬地环顾房间。

lines.en: She’s probably nervous that Rin will walk in on this and get the wrong idea or something.
lines.zh: 她大概是担心 Rin 会撞见这一幕，然后误会什么。

lines.en: Well...
Would it even count as “getting the wrong idea” here? Because it’s pretty obvious what this conversation has evolved into and Rin would very likely be getting the right idea.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这算得上“误会”吗？因为这场对话演变成了什么再明显不过，Rin 很可能恰恰是想对了。

lines.en: scene futabadten11
: H-Hey...Can I...ask you something, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿……嘿……我……能问你件事吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sure. But if it involves how you don't think you're attractive again, I'm probably going to hit you.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过要是又涉及你觉得不好看什么的，我大概会打你。

lines.en: : Lightly, of course. But I'll do it.
lines.zh: : 当然是轻轻地。但我真会打。

lines.en: scene futabadten13
: I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I just want to know why you've been spending so much time with me lately...
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，你最近为什么老是花这么多时间陪我……

lines.en: : Do I really need a reason to spend time with you? Can't I just do it because I want to?
lines.zh: : 我陪你真的需要理由吗？我就不能只是因为想这么做吗？

lines.en: : Of course, but...why do you want to?
lines.zh: : 当然可以，可是……你为什么想呢？

lines.en: : I'm...not as pretty as the other girls...or exciting...or even charismatic.
lines.zh: : 我……没有别的女孩漂亮……也不刺激……甚至连魅力都没有。

lines.en: : I just don't get why it seems like...you've been seeking me out when so many better options exist...
lines.zh: : 我就是不明白，明明有那么多更好的选择……你为什么偏偏要来找我……

lines.en: : Because I like to, Futaba. It's that simple.
lines.zh: : 因为我喜欢啊，Futaba。就这么简单。

lines.en: : And I know that’s probably not something I should be saying or doing at my age, but it’s the truth.
lines.zh: : 我知道以我的年纪，大概不该说也不该做这种事，可这是实话。

lines.en: scene futabadten14
Futaba doesn’t answer me right away.
lines.zh: Futaba 没有马上回答我。

lines.en: Instead, her eyes navigate to the floor and locate a smile somewhere along the way.
lines.zh: 相反，她的目光投向地板，然后在某处找到了一个微笑。

lines.en: It crawls onto her face like a spider, replacing the crooked frown of uncertainty that stood there just seconds ago.
lines.zh: 它像蜘蛛一样爬上她的脸，取代了几秒前还挂在那里的、因不安而扭曲的愁容。

lines.en: It’s a sincere smile- one that appears to have melted away all the bits and pieces of uneasiness in her body.
lines.zh: 那是一个真诚的微笑——似乎把她身体里所有不安的碎片都融化了。

lines.en: It’s a smile all for me.
lines.zh: 那是只属于我的微笑。

lines.en: I burn it into my retinas so that I may look back on it each time I close my eyes.
lines.zh: 我把它烙进视网膜，这样每次闭上眼睛，我都能回想起它。

lines.en: : You’re...really cool...
lines.zh: : 你……真的很棒……

lines.en: : I'll probably never understand why you keep choosing to hang out with me of all people...but I guess I have to respect your decision when you put it like that...
lines.zh: : 我大概永远也不会明白，为什么你偏偏一直选我陪你……不过你都这么说了，我想我得尊重你的决定……

lines.en: scene futabadten15
: And I’m...really sorry for acting strange tonight.
lines.zh: : 还有……今晚我举止很奇怪，真的很抱歉。

lines.en: : The conversation just went in...a direction I wasn't prepared for and...I didn't know how to handle it.
lines.zh: : 对话只是……走向了一个我没准备好面对的方向，而且……我不知道该怎么处理。

lines.en: : I’d really like it if you...kept coming here, though...
lines.zh: : 不过……我真的很希望你能……继续来这里……

lines.en: : Because...I really like spending time with you too, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 因为……我也真的很喜欢和你待在一起，Sensei……

lines.en: scene futabadten14
: Like...A lot...
lines.zh: : 非常……非常喜欢……

lines.en: scene futabadten15
: But...as much as I like it...I think you should probably head home before things...head in another direction I'm not really prepared for.
lines.zh: : 不过……虽然我很喜欢……我觉得你大概该回家了，免得事情……又走向另一个我没准备好面对的方向。

lines.en: : Do you think they would if I stayed around?
lines.zh: : 你觉得要是我留下来，它们会吗？

lines.en: : I'm not sure...
lines.zh: : 我不确定……

lines.en: : Lately...nothing really seems to be going the way I expect it to.
lines.zh: : 最近……好像什么都不会照我预想的发展。

lines.en: : So...I guess anything is really possible as long as I'm with you.
lines.zh: : 所以……我想只要和你在一起，什么都有可能。

lines.en: : And that's just a little scary to think about.
lines.zh: : 而光是想想就有点吓人。

lines.en: : Well, I don't want to scare you. So I'll head out now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不想吓到你。那我现在就走。

lines.en: : I’ll definitely be back, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我一定会再来的。

lines.en: : And hopefully, whatever happens next time won't make you think any less of me.
lines.zh: : 也希望下次发生的一切，不会让你因此对我不齿。

lines.en: : I'm sure it won't. You openly admitted to...f...fantasizing about me tonight and...that didn't make me think of you any less.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会。你今晚都公开承认……对……对我……想入非非了，而……那也没有让我因此对你不齿。

lines.en: : Cool. Because I'm planning on doing a little more of that as soon as I get home.
lines.zh: : 好。因为我打算一回家就再多做一点这种事。

lines.en: : I'm...going to ignore that you just said that and thank you again for stopping by, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我……就当你没说过那句话，然后再一次谢谢你过来，Sensei。

lines.en: : Have a good night.
lines.zh: : 祝你晚安。

lines.en: : You too, Futaba...
lines.zh: : 你也是，Futaba……

lines.en: scene black
: See you soon.
lines.zh: : 回头见。

lines.en: Tonight...went well?
lines.zh: 今晚……还算顺利？

lines.en: Sure, now I’ve got to walk home concealing an erection, but I definitely feel like Futaba and I have somehow strengthened our friendship.
lines.zh: 当然，现在我得一边掩饰着勃起一边走回家，但我确实觉得，我和 Futaba 的友情不知怎么地加深了。

lines.en: Maybe even to the point where it's starting to morph into something a little more than that.
lines.zh: 甚至可能已经开始变成比友情更多一点的东西。

lines.en: I hope that whatever cuts its way through the cocoon is as beautiful as she is.
lines.zh: 我希望，那只破茧而出的东西，能和她一样美丽。
